path.id: Track Responsibility: Northumbria regional map (as is)
Place-based view of how referrals move, where responsibility changes hands, how staff work around the gaps, and what happens when those

Evidence: Northumbria site visit, 2 to 4 November 2026. Five interviews (P01 referral ops, P02/03 RTT and funding, P04 surgical booking lead, P05 cancer and 2WW booking), one gastro consultant session (C1) and
two session briefs (S1 outside e-RS and RTT, S2 surgical admin). Emerging findings, not yet validated.

â€¢ RTT Tracker App: replaced 40+ spreadsheets, shared comments, audit trail, role-based access. (P02/03)
â€¢ Protected A&G review slots with one owner stopped requests going unactioned. (P04)
â€¢ Dental to RMS to e-RS works well. Worth finding out why. (P01)
â€¢ e-RS to PAS sync of demographics and bookings on 2WW. Patient progress easy to see. (P05)
â€¢ Strong local relationships let gastro redirect patients without bouncing them back. (C1)
